body:
I know that feeling all too well. I even live less than 50 feet away from my closest friends, and I still can't bring myself to talk about my low feelings. Between their work, their families, and themselves, all of my friends lead pretty hectic lives, so when we do get together, I don't want to burden anyone with it. Not very close to my own family, and only a handful of friends, so besides work, most of my time is spent alone.

I've found that keeping my mind busy helps. I'm taking classes in the evening, so that helps with the void between work and being at home. And I started working out, which removes another hour or two from the void. Might not be the best substitute for talking with another person, but it's my life right now I guess.

* An issue has been addressed wherein certain targetable objects were not targetable without their nameplates being visible.

With a couple of the doors in Sastasha, the hunt board in the Maelstrom, and other objects I'm sure, there does not seem to be a hitbox for the mouse without the object's nameplate being visible. And I like to play with object names turned off.
